hero.title: SetLux
hero.subtitle: Lighting department management.
hero.lead: All your technical workflow, organized in one place.

whatIs.title: What is SetLux?
whatIs.lead1: SetLux is a tool to organize and centralize the lighting department’s work, built from real on‑set experience.

benefits.label: BENEFITS
benefits.title: Why SetLux?
benefits.subtitle: A clearer, more professional and reliable way to work in the lighting department.

homeItem.title: Less on‑set improvisation
homeItem.description: All information centralized to reduce errors and time loss.

saveTime.title: Less management, more shooting
saveTime.description: Reduce repetitive tasks, eliminate duplication and centralize all project information in one place.

reduceErrors.title: Reliable calculations
reduceErrors.description: Avoid errors in workdays, overtime and economic concepts thanks to automatic calculations based on real conditions.

documentation.title: Clear PDFs ready for production
documentation.description: Generate professional documents directly from the calendar and reports, without redoing information.

transparency.title: Everything visible, everything clear
transparency.description: Workdays, extras, per diems and payroll are always visible and verifiable for the whole team.

allInOne.title: A single workflow
allInOne.description: From conditions to payroll, the entire lighting‑department workflow connected in one tool.

legal.title: Aligned with the agreement
legal.description: Conditions, workdays and calculations based on the collective agreement and real audiovisual‑sector practices.

useCases.label: USE CASES
useCases.title: Use cases
useCases.subtitle: How SetLux adapts to different types of shoots in the lighting department.

fiction.title: Fiction and television
fiction.description: For shoots with weekly continuity, stable crews and precise control of workdays, rest and labor conditions.
features: Team organization by days and phases
Automatic payroll calculation from the calendar

ads.title: Advertising
ads.description: Designed for shoots with specific conditions, variable crews and advertising‑style schedules.
features: Managing reinforcements, special days and holidays

features.label: FEATURES
features.title: Main features
features.subtitle: Tools designed for real lighting‑department work, from set to payroll.

labor.title: Shoot conditions
labor.description: Configure the economic and labor conditions of the shoot: workdays, overtime, per diems, night work, and holidays.

team.title: Team Management
team.description: Organize the lighting team by roles and work phases: base, extra, prelight and wrap.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Plan shooting weeks, locations, team, and technical needs in a single operational calendar.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Log the day‑to‑day of the shoot: overtime, turnarounds, night work, per diems, transport and any economic concept for the team.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.description: Automatically calculate team payroll from the calendar and reports, with a clear breakdown and exports for production, accounting and each worker individually.

cta.title: Organize your work with more clarity.
cta.text: SetLux is in active development and we’re looking for professionals to test it.

footer.description: The complete solution for managing the lighting department in audiovisual productions.
footer.bottom2: Designed specifically for lighting department professionals.
